newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish stocks close lower in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish stocks close lower in continuous trade.

text.p: Five stocks closed lower and one was flat in a 1.3-million-zloty turnover in Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Monday.
The remaining nine stocks did not trade.
NFI units fell in a 21.7-million-zloty turnover.
The continuous trading system, which currently lists 15 companies, is separate from the bourse's main single-price auction system in which the same firms and 68 others are traded.
At the single-price auction session most stocks rose and the main market's index rose 0.5 percent.
